taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: Docker BuildKit secret lifecycle and image/cache distribution

controls.boundary: Container build secret and layer retention boundary — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Open Dockerfile, context ignore rules, build arguments, secret mounts, layer/export metadata, build logs and cache export/access. Identify actual sensitive inputs using synthetic markers.
controls.controlled_verification: Build only an owned fixture with a fake secret marker and inspect relevant exported layers/history/logs/cache. Distinguish copying a secret then deleting it in a later layer from avoiding persistence in the first place. Record the build engine/settings used.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A secret mount directive alone is not a leak; using a fake marker in an inaccessible build-only context does not establish recipient exposure. Conversely, deleting a file in the final image does not erase prior exported layers.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use supported ephemeral secret delivery and prevent the evidenced persistence/export path. Retest required build behavior and search the actual distributed artifacts for the fake marker.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
